title: chore(console): back-fill the eager-closure baseline's squash merge
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuJyLDyhPTFkFALvgwhFG59d)_

Part of #37444. Part of #37572. The follow-up the review of #37786 asked for: that pull request re-pinned the eager-closure budget's `BASELINE` at its branch commit `003fde60`, and it landed on `main` as the squash `50b4bf82`. This records the squash in `BASELINE.squashMerge`, so the baseline's provenance names a commit that exists on `main`.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：没有。只改控制台首屏字节门禁脚本里的一条出处记录（基线来自哪个 main 提交），不改任何发布的包。
- 为什么做：#37786 合并后，审核要求把基线的合并提交补上，免得以后有人按分支提交去找却在 main 上找不到。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是这条出处写错；门禁的数值（上限、基线字节）一个都没动。

## What changes

- `ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`: `BASELINE.squashMerge: '50b4bf82'`, and the provenance prose says which commit is the branch head and which is the squash.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-eager-closure-budget.test.ts`: the ledger case expects both commits (`commitsCarriedBy(BASELINE)` equals `[commit, squashMerge]`) and pins `squashMerge` to `50b4bf82`.

No ceiling, baseline byte count or per-chunk row changes. `ui/` is a private workspace script, so this publishes nothing and carries `skip-changeset`.

## Why

The seat's ACCEPT on #37786 asked for the back-fill after merge.

## Verification

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-eager-closure-budget.test.ts`: 174 passed.
- `git cat-file -t 50b4bf82` on `main`: a commit (the squash of #37786).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
